title: An app that I need and would recommend 👍🏻
body:
At first I was just going to try it out because I have tried a couple of apps by now to help control my impulsiveness. But most of them didn’t really appeal to me and some are just way out of my budget. 

I just wanna say that this app has it all: 

(1) blocking certain apps you want to block at a specific time, 

(2) the automatic interventions whenever you open the app you are trying to avoid or lessen the usage,

(3) the countdown/timer that will make you see how much time you’re spending scrolling through social media apps (while also tracking your real intention for using it) and many more *chef’s kiss* it’s just perfect! 🤩 

These are just the features that I love! ❤️ 

I already feel like a different person because it saves me time and from doom scrolling. From 5-7 hours of screen time, I was able to lessen it to 30 mins max a day. This app helps me to be aware and to stay focused 💪🏻 Talk about effectiveness 💯 but I must say that a part of it also comes from discipline and with the intention of trying something out to help change the bad habit. 

For first time users like me, it can be challenging to set it up at first if you’re not used to setting up automations, but the steps are provided in the app so you won’t get lost 😊 

It’s the fairest of them all and at an affordable price 👏🏻 I’m a current Structured Pro user and I’m taking advantage of the discounted offer. 
Kudos to the developer/s. This app is wonderful and a great help!
